description: Convert CSV to JSON (array of objects keyed by the header row) and JSON arrays back to CSV. Handles quoted fields with embedded delimiters, escaped quotes and multi-line values per RFC 4180 conventions. Use this when an agent needs to cSV to array-of-objects and back, with quote handling. x402 price $0.01/call (USDC, eip155:8453).
name: dev_csv_convert
title: CSV ↔ JSON Converter
